# Finding the Percentage of the Ball Covered by Spots

## Setting Up the Radii

**Ball radius:** From the great circle circumference:
$$2\pi R = 54 \implies R = \frac{27}{\pi} \text{ cm}$$

**Spot base-circle radius:** From each spot's circumference:
$$2\pi r = 11 \implies r = \frac{11}{2\pi} \text{ cm}$$

## Computing the Spherical Cap Height

For a spherical cap on a sphere of radius $R$ with base radius $r$:
$$h = R - \sqrt{R^2 - r^2}$$

Computing $R^2 - r^2$:
$$R^2 - r^2 = \frac{729}{\pi^2} - \frac{121}{4\pi^2} = \frac{2916 - 121}{4\pi^2} = \frac{2795}{4\pi^2}$$

$$\sqrt{R^2 - r^2} = \frac{\sqrt{2795}}{2\pi}$$

$$h = \frac{27}{\pi} - \frac{\sqrt{2795}}{2\pi} = \frac{54 - \sqrt{2795}}{2\pi}$$

## Computing Areas

**One spherical cap** (area $= 2\pi R h$):
$$A_{\text{cap}} = 2\pi \cdot \frac{27}{\pi} \cdot \frac{54 - \sqrt{2795}}{2\pi} = \frac{27(54 - \sqrt{2795})}{\pi}$$

**All 30 spots:**
$$A_{\text{spots}} = 30 \cdot \frac{27(54 - \sqrt{2795})}{\pi} = \frac{810(54 - \sqrt{2795})}{\pi}$$

**Sphere surface:**
$$A_{\text{sphere}} = 4\pi R^2 = 4\pi \cdot \frac{729}{\pi^2} = \frac{2916}{\pi}$$

## Computing the Percentage

$$\text{Percentage} = \frac{A_{\text{spots}}}{A_{\text{sphere}}} \times 100 = \frac{810(54 - \sqrt{2795})}{2916} \times 100$$

Simplifying $\frac{810}{2916} = \frac{5}{18}$:

$$= \frac{5(54 - \sqrt{2795})}{18} \times 100$$

## Numerical Evaluation

$$\sqrt{2795} \approx 52.8678$$

$$54 - 52.8678 = 1.1322$$

$$\frac{5 \times 1.1322}{18} \times 100 = \frac{5.6612}{18} \times 100 \approx 31.45\%$$
